answers.puzzle_1_rating_reason: Wasn't sure about some of them, so tried to guess, but then forgot which I was certain of and which I guessed
answers.puzzle_2_rating_reason: There were larger numbers, so it was easier to deduce which cells for sure had to be black/white
answers.puzzle_3_rating_reason: I got better at using the deductive reasoning, and also avoided guessing because it made everything more confusing
answers.strategy: Looking at where the big numbers were, for ex. 6 or 8, and seeing where the cells definitely have to be black because of the overlap of the large number. Or, cells that had a lot of numbers, such as 1, 1, 1, 1, 2 or something like that, where the white cells in between mean there is an easy way to figure out the only possible order.
answers.comments: Practice definitely made it easier, and the hints helped also build confidence and expadite the process
